ccldr: R client for the CCLD Transparency API

Source: R/ccldr-package.R
ccldr-package.Rd

Verify facility license numbers, pull rich per-facility detail, snapshot Alameda child-care facilities, and append Census geographies using public CCLD and Census APIs.

Package options

ccldr.delay

Seconds between requests in batch mode. Default 0.5.

ccldr.cache_ttl_seconds

Cache TTL in seconds. Default 86400 (24 hours).

ccldr.verbose

If TRUE, log one line per HTTP request. Default FALSE.

See also

  • ccld_verify() to verify many license numbers.

  • ccld_facility() to fetch full detail for one license.

  • ccld_alameda() to build live Alameda facility snapshots.

  • ccld_add_census_geographies() to append geocodes and Census geography.
